VSOL V1601E02-DP 2-Port EPON OLT | 10G Uplink for High-Performance Networks

Enhance Your Network with the V.SOL V1601E02-DP EPON OLT – High-Speed, Scalable & Reliable

The V.SOL V1601E02-DP 2-Port EPON OLT is a high-performance optical line terminal (OLT) designed for enterprise networks, ISPs, and large-scale FTTH deployments. Equipped with 10G uplink ports, 2 EPON ports, and high-speed RJ45/SFP interfaces, this OLT delivers exceptional network efficiency, scalability, and stability. Its compact 1U rack-mount design and low power consumption make it ideal for cost-effective fiber network expansion.

Key Features:

  • High-Speed Connectivity – Supports 10G SFP+ uplinks for ultra-fast data transmission
  • Scalable EPON Network – 2 EPON ports with a 1:64 maximum splitting ratio, enabling seamless multi-user connectivity
  • Multiple Interfaces – 4 RJ45 ports + 2 SFP/SFP+ slots for flexible network integration
  • High Backplane Bandwidth – 128 Gbps backplane switching capacity ensures smooth data flow
  • Fast Data Processing – Port forwarding rate of 38.688 Mpps for high-speed packet transmission
  • Energy-Efficient Design – Low power consumption (30W) for cost-effective operation
  • Wide Operating Temperature Range – Functions reliably from -20°C to +60°C, perfect for diverse environments

Technical Specifications:

  • Uplink Ports: 4 x RJ45 + 2 x SFP/SFP+
  • EPON Ports: 2 x EPON (1:64 max splitting ratio)
  • Supported PON Modules: PX20, PX20+, PX20++, PX20+++, PX20++++
  • Backplane Bandwidth: 128 Gbps
  • Port Forwarding Rate: 38.688 Mpps
  • Power Supply: AC 100~240V, 50/60 Hz | DC -48V
  • Power Consumption: 30W Max
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Humidity: 5% to 95% (non-condensing)
  • Dimensions: 442mm (L) x 200mm (W) x 43.6mm (H) (1U Rackmount Design)

What’s in the Box?

  • 1x V.SOL V1601E02-DP EPON OLT
  • 1x Power Adapter (AC/DC)
  • 1x User Manual

Why Choose V.SOL V1601E02-DP EPON OLT?

  • Ideal for FTTH, ISP, and Enterprise Networks – Delivers scalable, high-performance fiber connectivity
  • Efficient Bandwidth Distribution – Supports 1:64 EPON splitting, allowing multiple connections with stable performance
  • Reliable & Cost-Effective – Low power consumption, high-speed processing, and durable design
  • Seamless Network Expansion – 10G uplinks, SFP/SFP+ support, and multiple RJ45 ports for flexible networking
